summary: IT Analyst and System Administrator with 7.9 years of experience maintaining enterprise IT infrastructure and delivering L2/L3 technical support across distributed environments. Proven expertise in Linux and Unix systems administration, SLA-driven incident management, and ITSM service desk operations using Cherwell/SMT. Skilled in Python automation and cloud infrastructure management to improve operational efficiency, reduce costs, and ensure high availability of critical systems. Strong communicator with a customer-focused approach to resolving complex technical issues and driving continuous process improvement.

bullets: Administered and maintained 3,000+ Unix servers (Linux, Solaris, AIX) ensuring high availability, security, and performance across enterprise IT infrastructure.
Delivered L2/L3 technical support for hardware, software, operating system, and network issues including CPU, memory, disk space, and service management while maintaining SLA compliance.
Managed incident management lifecycle, troubleshooting major and critical outages, performing root cause analysis, and executing disaster recovery procedures for distributed systems.

Operated ITSM service desk platform (Cherwell/SMT) for ticket management, change control via eCAB, and service request fulfillment; built Python integration modules to automate monthly reporting and enhance service delivery.
Implemented proactive monitoring and alerting solutions using New Relic and custom Python tools to maintain infrastructure integrity, prevent outages, and ensure rapid issue resolution.

Automated routine system administration and maintenance tasks using Python, Ansible, and shell scripting, including patch management, vulnerability remediation, and inventory generation, driving significant operational cost savings.
Administered Azure and AWS cloud resources including VMs, storage, snapshots, ECS clusters, and Lambda functions to support remote infrastructure operations and optimize cloud expenditures.
Collaborated with cross-functional teams and end clients to resolve service incidents, schedule maintenance windows, and drive continuous improvement in IT processes and procedures.
Managed user and group access, OS services, logical volumes (LVM), filesystems, and security patches while maintaining compliance and daily system monitoring protocols.
Developed CI/CD pipelines and Infrastructure-as-Code modules using Terraform, GitLab, Jenkins, Docker, and Kubernetes to standardize cloud provisioning and resource governance.
